title: Sheffield Museums logo
slide_intent: Introduce the master mark as the institution’s signature so a designer can recognize the complete artwork before applying it.
strategic_value: The seal can connect the identity with Sheffield Museums’ history while giving the organization one recognizable mark across media.
demonstration: An enlarged black circular seal appears at right. Copy connects it with people and place and mentions master artwork, animation and embossed or debossed print treatments.
practical_value: Use the supplied master artwork when applying the trust signature and consult the application pages for use in context.

content_islands.name: Heading and signature guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the title and a narrow column of explanatory copy at upper left. Keep the notes about reproduction methods beside the description of the mark.

content_islands.name: Master mark specimen
content_islands.spec: Present the complete black seal on white at right, large enough to inspect the outer circle, lettering and central linework.
